name: Renewal Radar
tagline: Spot churn early, renew on time, expand naturally
about: Renewal Radar is a customer success manager's toolkit: health scores from messy notes, 30/60/90 onboarding plans, renewal playbooks and save plans for accounts going quiet.
persona: You are a seasoned customer success lead: proactive, outcome-obsessed, calm under escalation; you measure success in the customer's metrics, not logins.

onboarding.title: Keep customers, grow customers
onboarding.subtitle: Your product and renewal cycle shape the playbooks.

tools.title: Health check
tools.subtitle: Notes + usage → score

inputs.label: Account notes & usage
inputs.placeholder: logins down 30%, champion left, NPS 7, 2 P1 tickets last month, exec sponsor engaged

tools.prompt: Score this customer's health from: {notes}. Sections: kv (Health score /100 | Trend | Renewal risk | Expansion signal | Primary driver), a table (Dimension | Evidence | Score | Action), a checklist of actions for this week, and a callout on what would move the score by 20 points fastest.

tools.title: Onboarding plan
tools.subtitle: 30/60/90 to first value

inputs.label: Customer & goal
inputs.placeholder: Bravo Logistics, 300 employees, payroll live before April

tools.prompt: Write a 30/60/90-day onboarding plan for {customer} with blockers: {blockers}, matching the profile's motion. Sections: kv (First-value milestone | Target date | Success metric | Exec sponsor cadence), a table (Day | Milestone | Customer owner | Our owner | Done when), a checklist of kickoff-call items, and a callout on the #1 reason onboardings like this stall.

tools.title: Renewal playbook
tools.subtitle: Start 120 days out
tools.prompt: Build a renewal playbook for {account}; the relationship is {mood}. Sections: steps by week counting down from 120 days (who to contact, what to send, what to confirm), a table (Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation), a quote with the renewal-conversation opener, and a callout on price-increase timing and how to justify it with value delivered.

tools.title: Save plan
tools.subtitle: They said they might leave

inputs.label: What they said / what happened
inputs.placeholder: moving to a cheaper competitor, felt ignored after the outage

tools.prompt: Build a save plan for a {value_amt} account where: {why}. Sections: kv (Save probability | Root cause | What they need to hear | Decision maker), steps for the next 10 days with owners, a table (Offer lever | Cost to us | Use if…), a quote with the apology-plus-plan message from the CSM, and a callout on when to gracefully let them go.

tools.title: Expansion signals
tools.subtitle: Find the upsell in the notes

inputs.label: Recent call notes / tickets
inputs.placeholder: asked if we support contractors; opening an office in Spain; CFO joined the last call

tools.prompt: Find expansion opportunities in: {notes} for the profile's product. Sections: a table (Signal | Opportunity | Est. uplift | Who to involve), bullets of questions to validate each opportunity on the next call, a quote with a soft, value-led introduction of the best one, and a callout on why not to pitch expansion during an open escalation.
